en.headline: Lawmaker calls for closer Greater Bay Area airport cooperation
en.dek: Kenneth Fok said Hong Kong International Airport passenger numbers remain below pre-pandemic levels and urged government-to-government deals with mainland airports.
body: Legislative Council member Kenneth Fok called on the government on Monday to strengthen cooperation with Greater Bay Area airports to reinforce Hong Kong’s position as an international aviation hub.

Fok, speaking for the G19 group of lawmakers, said the recommendations come as total passenger throughput at Hong Kong International Airport has not yet returned to pre-pandemic levels. He noted that the airport trails some regional competitors such as those in Shenzhen and Guangzhou in passenger volume.

He said regional collaboration among airports has become common and that the key for Hong Kong is more joint effort with Greater Bay Area airports. Fok suggested government-to-government agreements between Hong Kong and the mainland that could then be used in talks with partners in Europe and elsewhere.
He added that the government could take a more proactive approach in promoting the airport internationally to attract more foreign airlines.

zh.headline: 議員促加強大灣區機場合作
zh.dek: 霍啟剛表示香港國際機場客運量仍未回復疫前水平，呼籲政府與內地機場進行政府間協議。
body: 立法會議員霍啟剛周一呼籲政府加強與大灣區機場的合作，以鞏固香港作為國際航空樞紐的地位。
霍啟剛以G19議員團體代表發言，指建議是基於香港國際機場總客運量仍未回復至疫情前水平。他指出，機場在客運量上落後於深圳及廣州等部分區域競爭對手。
他表示區域機場之間的合作已成常態，香港的關鍵在於與大灣區機場有更多共同努力。霍啟剛建議香港與內地進行政府對政府協議，再以此與歐洲及其他地方的夥伴談判。
他補充，政府可以更主動地向國際推廣機場，以吸引更多外國航空公司。
